chapter.heading: To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
O LORD,
rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

Have mercy
upon me, O LORD; for I am weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.

My soul
is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?

Return, O
LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.

For in
death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

I am
weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

Mine eye
is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

Depart from
me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.

The LORD
hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.

Let all
mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.
